mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity cash flows and encourage risk-taking.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 9.5% signals a high unemployment environment that triggers aggressive monetary and fiscal policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5 and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (UNRATE > 9.5) and employment growth is weak (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to market pricing of imminent economic recovery.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5 AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL above 215), the S&P 500 produces negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher risk aversion.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 215 and 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST below 550 signals a bottoming housing market that triggers policy support and economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 550 and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are below 350000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) are below 550, the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 5 trading days due to market anticipation of economic stabilization.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 350000 AND HOUST < 550 and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 215 (moderate inflation) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals stable economic conditions without deflationary risks.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
